headline: Medium-Term Program Announced: Year-End Inflation Forecast Rises, Growth Forecast Updated
summary: Turkey's Medium-Term Program lowered its 2026 growth forecast to 3.3% and raised the year-end inflation expectation to 28.4%. An additional 250 billion lira in credit support is provided to manufacturing.
why: The Medium-Term Program is the government's official economic plan, setting the growth, inflation and fiscal assumptions that shape policy and investor expectations.
